title: Language Models can Evaluate Themselves via Probability Discrepancy
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical evaluation framework (ProbDiff) for measuring the performance of Large Language Models based on log-probability discrepancy. It tests these on standard benchmarks like MT-Bench and AlignBench and discusses natural language tasks like translation and summarization. It does not contain any sections or evaluation components regarding religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
